meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能操控浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据。页面状态会在多次操作间保留,所以适合分步干活:先做一步、看下结果再继续。运行方式有两种:新开一个独立浏览器窗口,或连上你正在用的 Chrome。
howto.when: 当用户想要操作浏览器时触发,例如打开网址、填表、截图等。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并等它加载完,截个图
say.note: 它会启动浏览器访问页面并保存截图。

say.text: 在 Hacker News 上找到第一条链接,点进去,告诉我标题
say.note: 它会先看页面的无障碍快照,再定位那个链接点击。

say.text: 帮我把这个登录页的账号密码填好,先别提交
say.note: 它会定位输入框填好内容,等你确认后再提交。

howto.what_en: Claude can control a browser to open web pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, and scrape data. Page state persists between steps, so it works incrementally: do one action, check the result, then continue. Works with a fresh Chromium or the user's existing Chrome.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to interact with a browser, e.g., open a URL, fill a form, or take a screenshot.

say_en.text: Open example.com, wait for it to load, and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: It will start a browser session and save the screenshot to a file.

say_en.text: On Hacker News, find the first link, click it, and tell me the title.
say_en.note: It reads the page snapshot first, then clicks the right link.

say_en.text: Fill in the username and password on this login page, but don't submit yet.
say_en.note: It fills the fields and waits for your confirmation before submitting.
